title: heterotheca villosa var. scabra
intro: Heterotheca villosa var. scabra, commonly known as Rough Yellowtop, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rough Yellowtop include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
